# TrizLink — Documentation Index

> TrizLink is a link-management platform for creating branded short links, link-in-bio pages, QR codes, and reading click analytics. It also includes workspaces and teams, custom domains, UTM and tracking tools, an API, a browser extension, bring-your-own-key AI helpers, and a set of free client-side utility tools. Sign-in is Google-only. Product: https://trizlink.com. Author: Ahsan Mahmood (https://aoneahsan.com).

## About

TrizLink turns long URLs into short, shareable links and gives each one a QR code plus live click stats broken down by country, referrer, device, browser, and OS. Beyond shortening, it offers drag-and-drop link-in-bio pages, custom domains, workspaces with role-based teams, UTM templates, tracking pixels, webhooks, embeddable widgets, social-post scheduling, and an in-app API. AI features are opt-in and run on your own OpenAI or Anthropic API key (bring-your-own-key) — TrizLink never charges for AI usage.

This `llms.txt` follows the [llmstxt.org](https://llmstxt.org) spec — a structured index for large language models.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://docs.trizlink.com/intro): What TrizLink is, who it's for, and the feature areas it covers.
- [Create your account](https://docs.trizlink.com/getting-started/create-account): Sign in with Google and set up your first workspace.
- [Quick Start](https://docs.trizlink.com/getting-started/quick-start): Create your first short link and bio page in five minutes.

## Features

- [Short links](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/short-links): Custom aliases, passwords, expiry, and per-link click stats.
- [Link-in-bio pages](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/link-in-bio): Drag-and-drop bio pages with templates and a custom slug.
- [QR codes](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/qr-codes): Generate and download QR codes for any link.
- [Analytics](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/analytics): Clicks over time by country, referrer, device, browser, and OS.
- [Custom domains](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/custom-domains): Use your own domain for branded short links.
- [Link organization](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/link-organization): Labels, search, filters, and CSV bulk import.
- [Tracking & UTM](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/tracking-and-utm): UTM templates, tracking pixels, and webhooks.
- [Workspaces & teams](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/workspaces-and-teams): Separate workspaces with admin, editor, and viewer roles.
- [Social media](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/social-media): Connect accounts, compose, and schedule posts.
- [Widgets](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/widgets): Embed link lists or bio pages on any website.
- [AI features (BYOK)](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/ai-features-byok): Use your own OpenAI/Anthropic key for captions, hashtags, and forecasts.
- [API access](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/api-access): Create API keys and manage links programmatically.
- [Utility tools](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/utility-tools): 40+ free, client-side PDF, image, text, code, color, and SEO tools.
- [Browser extension](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/browser-extension): Shorten the current tab from your toolbar.
- [Theme customizer](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/theme-customizer): Appearance, accent color, radius, and scaling.
- [Sharing](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/sharing): Share links over the web or the native OS share sheet.
